summary: BioHarvest Sciences Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing its Notice of Annual General Meeting and Information Circular for a meeting scheduled June 25, 2026. The filing covers routine items: setting board size at seven, electing Class I and Class II directors, appointing auditors, and receiving audited financial statements. The record date is May 19, 2026. There are no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, or restructuring. This is a standard AGM notice and proxy circular. The filing is a foreign private issuer report and contains no event-driven special situation.
